services.name: Private Sailboat Cruise
services.desc: Duration 2.5 Hour Cruises Private Sail Charter About About: Captain Mike, Seaside Sailing's Captain, is a licensed US Coast Guard Master Captain and has been sailing for over 50 years and chartering sailboat cruises for over 30 years. He and Captain Diane have a passion for sailing on the open water and traveling via sailboat to new places. They spent the winter months in Florida aboard Express Mail for the past 18 years. They would love to take you out on their beloved sailboat, Express Mail, and show you the beautiful waters of the Barnegat Bay and the Toms River.
